evidence.explanation: The explicit-coordinate branch calls pos_to_room only for a discarded return. Its inside_room traversal has no side effects, so omitting this attribution does not change branch construction in the tested domain.
evidence.proof: 144 exact-C/production-JS explicit-coordinate cases: no rooms, regular interior, irregular interior, irregular edge ×ROOM/CORR/AIR ×both endpoints ×BR_STAIR/BR_NO_END1/BR_NO_END2 ×both directions. C lookup returns room in72 cases and null in72. All agree on made_branch, resulting terrain/direction and stair-list position/destination/traversed truth value;96 construct stairs and48 intentionally lack the current endpoint. 288 controls exercise made_branch and null-branch early returns, with no stairs.
evidence.control: No random coordinate selection, portals/debug_fuzzer, stairs-overwrite, runtime travel, full dungeon initialization or broad metadata alias parity. The C returned room is read only; source dependency changes to place_branch, pos_to_room or inside_room invalidate this proof. Undefined JS u_traversed is compared by its production truth-value semantics, not raw property presence.
